messages:
Maya: Quick check — we need final RICE + launch guardrails for the Q2 roadmap by EOD. I updated the spreadsheet with 6 candidates and a proposed guardrail column (SLOs, rollback, perf budget). Can folks re-score and flag blockers?

Arun: On it. Did we change the RICE formula or still Impact*Confidence/Effort?

Maya: Still the same formula but want to recalibrate confidence to be more evidence-based (customer signal, telemetry, prototype). I'm +10% on Impact if we have enterprise pilot in the bucket.

Priya: Re: guardrails — can we add a quality gate: no more than 2% regression on generation accuracy and latency <200ms p95 for hosted tier? Otherwise rollback plan required. cc @Sam

Sam: Agree. Also need design capacity note — any "UX overhaul" items should include a week for research + another for copy iteration.

Carlos: For the embedding index work, impact looks high but confidence is medium. Asking for an experiment signal from support logs. I'll drop a quick data slice.

Jen: Suggest we separate "customer urgency" (how many paying customers asked) from "strategic impact" and show both in the sheet. Helps sequencing.

Quan: Sequencing note — the infra refactor is a hard blocker for A/B rollout of #3. If we don't reserve infra work in Q2, we should deprioritize the dependent items.

planning-bot: doc updated: https://redwood-internal/roadmap/q2-scorer — latest scores and guardrails added by Maya

Maya: I'm going to propose this adjusted scoring rule in the sheet:
```
score = round((impact * confidence) / effort, 1)
impact: 1-10, confidence: 0.1-1.0, effort: 1-8
add columns: customer_asks (count), strategic_flag (yes/no), guardrails (text)
```

Arun: Posted my scores. Quick read:
- infra-refactor: 6.8 (blocker)
- embeddings-stability: 7.2
- streaming-cost-optim: 5.1

Priya: Posted scores and added proposed guardrails for each. For embedding: require 99.9% ingestion success for 3 days before rollout.

Carlos: Data slice uploaded. embedding request rate top 10 accounts shows 60% of traffic from 3 customers — raises concentration risk.

Maya: OK — can we get final thumbs by 3pm so I can lock the doc and send to GTM? If any vetoes on the guardrails, call them out now.

Jen: Thumbs from me. :thumbsup:

Sam: Thumbs. :white_check_mark:

Arun: One question — do we apply a multiplier for enterprise revenue-signed deals? Might bump things. I'm neutral but flagging.

Maya: Noted. I added an "enterprise-commit" binary that adds +1 to impact if >$50k ARR signed. Will annotate which items get it.

Quan: Leaving a note that infra time is constrained; recommend we split infra into M1 (safety fixes) and M2 (performance). M1 must be pre-req.

planning-bot: reminder: scoring window closes in 2 hours

Maya: Thanks team — I'll compile final ranking and call a 15m sync if there are >2 major conflicts.
